sandbox.title: Wi-Fi in every hostel room
sandbox.problem: Hostel rooms need dependable Wi-Fi for coursework, online classes and exams. Signal inside concrete hostels drops quickly through walls and floor slabs, so a few access points per building leave many rooms with weak or no signal.
sandbox.objectives:
Good signal (-67 dBm or better) in at least 95% of the floor area of every hostel, on every floor.
A bill of quantities and running cost the University can budget for.
sandbox.sustainability: Access points report to one campus controller run by the computer centre; the running cost covers power and yearly maintenance.
sandbox.summary: Access points on every floor of the 16 mapped hostels, placed by the Sandbox for good signal (-67 dBm).
sandbox.implementation:
1. Walk each hostel with a phone Wi-Fi analyser to record today's signal and check the model.
2. Confirm access point positions room by room; adjust for corridors and stairwells.
3. Lay PoE cabling floor by floor, mount the access points, connect them to the campus controller.
4. Re-survey and fine-tune power and channels.
